::: {.obsidian-sow}
:::

State the purpose of the engagement in one paragraph. Name the
background, the context, and the desired outcome.

# Scope

State what the work covers and what it excludes. Name the systems,
the data, and the boundaries.

# Deliverables

List the deliverables. For each, name the form and the acceptance
criteria.

# Milestones

List the milestones with their dates and owners. Use a table.

# Acceptance

State the acceptance process. Name who accepts each deliverable,
the review period, and the criteria applied.
